candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record describes a 2-year-old with paracorporeal continuous-flow LVAD implantation and recurrent embolic strokes requiring pump exchange. These findings (LVAD use, embolic strokes, pump exchange) are complications/manifestations of the underlying cardiomyopathy. The reference diagnosis is dilated cardiomyopathy, which is the primary etiology necessitating LVAD support in a pediatric patient of this age and size. LVAD thrombosis with embolic stroke is a complication of the device used to treat dilated cardiomyopathy, not the primary diagnostic entity itself.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: LVAD thrombosis with embolic stroke describes a complication/manifestation rather than the underlying primary diagnosis of dilated cardiomyopathy
